items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional only for bounded internal evidence work. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. The Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics, not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; public terms restrict relevant uses. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, external rights request, affiliate use, advertising, or public display. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task may close because required field rights, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not send outreach or close tasks without direct evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and use limits, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert rights, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet; produce the read-only data-flow and retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration without enabling new tracking; and produce the read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Fleet compliance disposition: technical baseline only, not legal certification. Compliance reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; revenue is limited to a 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon result of $4.92 that cannot be assigned to a site. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or as a standalone launch blocker, but do not claim attribution, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Continue only existing containment, measurement, evidence, and parked-site readiness work.

For private or parked properties, retain the concrete decision: keep private, preview-only, and unlaunched until ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence are attached. Continue the existing readiness packet only; no publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Retain containment-only execution. The existing failed-work repair, deployed-change measurement, period-aligned revenue reconciliation, security evidence capture, and parked-site readiness work may continue. Do not admit new queue work, retry unchanged failures, deploy, expand monetization, add tracking, or conduct external outreach. Reassess only after dated evidence is recorded.
